title: GMI theme-graph probation proposal v1
description: One LINE of data/theme_graph/probation/proposals.jsonl (append-only JSONL). NOTHING HERE IS PRODUCTION VOCABULARY: the graph build ignores every row whose status is not 'ratified', and ratification is a curated act (G0.6/G0.13 — a string match or an overlap statistic may never promote itself into an edge). Rows are keep-first on proposal_id, a deterministic hash of the proposal's subject, so re-running a proposer re-proposes nothing and never overwrites a curator's decision.

proposal_id.description: 'prop:' + sha1(kind|subject)[:16]. Deterministic: the same finding on the same subject is the same row.

kind.description: What is being proposed. key_rename and identity_continuity come from the refresh path (a source key or a ticker that may have been renamed rather than deleted-and-added); mapping and new_theme from the overlap and coverage-gap diagnostics.

subject.description: What the proposal is about — the ids/keys involved. Hashed into proposal_id, so it is the row's identity, not commentary.

evidence.description: The statistics or observations behind the proposal (overlap counts, Jaccard, containments, member-set signatures). Free-form by design: a curator needs the numbers that were actually computed, not a lowest-common-denominator subset of them.

evidence_refs.description: evidence_id values or artifact paths supporting the proposal.

proposed_by.description: Which organ proposed it. A proposal whose origin is not named cannot be audited later. llm_proposed is registered here so an LLM proposal is visibly a PROPOSAL and can never be mistaken for a minted fact.

ratified_by.description: The operator or delegated curation session that ratified. Required when status=ratified, forbidden otherwise — a ratification without an author is not a ratification.
